item.title: Seiken Tsukai no Proposition
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: UnicoЯn, Project L.A
  • 発売日: 2016-05-27
  • スコア: 7.17/10 (76 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 聖鍵遣いの命題
  • 英語名: Seiken Tsukai no Proposition

别名

  • Seiken Tsukai no Meidai

あらすじ

This is the debut work for UnicoЯn.

There exists a legend about a king who obtained a relic from a lost civilization and used its power to grant any wish to unite the world. This relic, ‘Sora no Ison’ (Legacy of the Sky), was sealed afterwards by the ‘holy keys’ somewhere in the world. Countless persons have attempted to find it, but none of them could even find a trace of its location.
